publisher: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
document: Mapping greenhouse gas emissions and removals for the LULUCF sector — Annex 2
rows: Forestry | Forest land remaining forest land | Carbon stock change in biomass and mineral soils for forests > 20 years old. Emissions from drainage of mineral soils under forest.

Forestry | Land converted from forest land | Carbon stock change in biomass and mineral soils from deforested land. Direct and indirect N2O emissions from soil mineralisation following deforestation. Emissions from controlled burning following deforestation.

Forestry | Land converted to forest land | Carbon stock change in biomass and mineral soils from forests < 20 years old. Direct and indirect N2O emissions from soil mineralisation from forests < 20 years old. Direct and indirect N2O emissions from forest fertilisation.
Forestry | Harvested wood products | Carbon stock change from harvested wood products from all forest. Note this is not disaggregated to LA scale.

Cropland mineral soils change | Cropland remaining cropland | Carbon stock change in mineral soils from cropland > 20 years old. Direct and indirect N2O emissions from soil mineralisation from cropland >20 years old are reported in the Agriculture sector.
Cropland mineral soils change | Grassland converted to cropland | Carbon stock change in mineral soils from cropland < 20 years old. Direct and indirect N2O emissions from soil mineralisation.
Cropland mineral soils change | Settlement converted to cropland | Carbon stock change in mineral soils from cropland < 20 years old.
Grassland mineral soils change | Cropland converted to grassland | Carbon stock change in mineral soils from grassland < 20 years old.
Grassland mineral soils change | Grassland remaining grassland | Carbon stock change in mineral soils from grassland > 20 years old. Direct and indirect N2O emissions from soil mineralisation.
Grassland mineral soils change | Settlement converted to grassland | Carbon stock change in mineral soils from grassland < 20 years old.
Peatland | Cropland drained | Emissions from drained cropland on organic soils. Not including N2O which is reported in the Agriculture sector.
Peatland | Domestic extraction | On-site emissions from domestic peat extraction (fuel use).
Peatland | Eroding modified bog drained | Emissions from drained eroding modified bog (bare peat).
Peatland | Eroding modified bog undrained | Emissions from undrained eroding modified bog (bare peat).
Peatland | Extensive grassland drained | Emissions from drained extensive grassland on organic soils.
Peatland | Forest drained | Emissions from drained forest on organic soils.
Peatland | Industrial extraction | On-site and off-site emissions from industrial peat extraction (horticultural use).
Peatland | Intensive grassland drained | Emissions from drained intensive grassland on organic soils. Not including N2O which is reported in the Agriculture sector.
Peatland | Modified bog drained | Emissions from drained modified bog (semi-natural heather and grass dominated bog).
Peatland | Modified bog undrained | Emissions from undrained modified bog (semi-natural heather and grass dominated bog).
Peatland | Near-natural bog | Emissions/removals from near-natural bog.
Peatland | Near-natural fen | Emissions/removals from near-natural fen.
Peatland | Rewetted bog | Emissions from rewetted bog.
Peatland | Rewetted fen | Emissions from rewetted fen.
Peatland | Rewetted modified bog | Emissions from rewetted modified (semi-natural) bog.
Peatland | Settlement drained | Emissions from drained settlement on organic soils.
Settlement | Settlement remaining settlement | Carbon stock change in mineral soils from settlement > 20 years old. Direct and indirect N2O emissions from soil mineralisation.
Settlement | Land converted to settlement | Carbon stock change in mineral soils and biomass from settlement < 20 years old. Direct and indirect N2O emissions from soil mineralisation.
Bioenergy crops | Miscanthus | Carbon stock change in biomass and mineral soils from the management of Miscanthus crops.
Bioenergy crops | Short rotation coppice | Carbon stock change in biomass and mineral soils from the management of short rotation coppice crops.
Other LULUCF | Forest miscellaneous | Emissions from wildfires on forest land.

Other LULUCF | Cropland miscellaneous | Emissions from wildfires on cropland. Carbon stock change from non-forest biomass on land converted to cropland. Carbon stock change in biomass and mineral soils from the management of non-bioenergy crops.

Other LULUCF | Grassland miscellaneous | Emissions from wildfires on grassland. Carbon stock change from non-forest biomass on land converted to grassland. Carbon stock change in biomass from grassland management.
Other LULUCF | Wetland miscellaneous | Carbon stock change in biomass from reservoir creation.
